title: 紫薇讳纹样挂件
summary: 红色文字映衬深色底面，简洁而醒目的传统纹样。
summary_en: Red inscription against a dark ground gives this traditional motif a clear visual focus.
body:
照片中的挂件以红色紫薇讳纹样为视觉中心，搭配深色长方形底面与挂绳。鲜明的对比，让书写形态本身成为这款佩饰的主要看点。

原图将纹样与传统护佑寓意联系在一起。此处介绍其文化主题，不承诺具体效果。原图中的「朱砂」文字不作为本页对实际成分的确认，材质需向协会核实。
body_en:
A red Ziwei sacred inscription forms the focal point of this pendant, set against a dark rectangular face and paired with a cord. The strong contrast directs attention to the written form itself.

The source image connects the motif with traditional protection symbolism. This page describes the cultural theme without promising an effect. The source's reference to cinnabar is not a verified statement of this item's composition; ask the Association to confirm materials.
